title: AGI Knowledge Graph — World States, Research, Story Elements

utopia.name: The Utopia (AI Abundance)
utopia.ai_capability: AI solves climate change, cures diseases, eliminates poverty
utopia.economics: Post-scarcity. Labor productivity at 5.7%. GDP doubles every 4.5 years
utopia.society: Humans freed from drudgery. Meaning from creativity, relationships, exploration
utopia.sleep_angle: In this world, you fall asleep knowing the future is bright.
story_seeds: What do humans do when work ends?

dystopia.name: The Dystopia (AI Concentration)
dystopia.ai_capability: AI is powerful but controlled by a few
dystopia.economics: Richest 1% hold nearly half of global wealth. Inequality soars
dystopia.society: Corporations dominate. Humans spend most time in VR with AI companions
dystopia.sleep_angle: In this world, you fall asleep knowing the game is rigged.
evidence: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google control frontier models
AI companies worth more than most countries
BCG: 'companies play states against each other'

slow_fade.name: The Slow Fade (AI Gradual Takeover)
slow_fade.source: LessWrong: A History of the Future
slow_fade.ai_capability: AI gradually takes over tasks, one by one
slow_fade.economics: GDP grows but jobs disappear. New jobs emerge but fewer people fill them
slow_fade.society: Humans become less relevant. Not replaced — just sidelined
slow_fade.sleep_angle: In this world, you fall asleep knowing the world is changing, and you're not sure if you're keeping up.
story_seeds: What happens to the middle class?
evidence: AI already doing coding, research, customer service
Metaculus: 'AI researchers at human expert level by 2030'
LessWrong: 'AI codegen scaffolds get good enough to replace'

merger.name: The Merger (Human-AI Integration)
merger.ai_capability: AI merges with humans. Brain-computer interfaces. Digital consciousness
merger.economics: New form of labor. Humans + AI = superhuman
merger.society: The line between human and machine blurs. Identity changes
merger.risk: Medium-High. What does it mean to be human?
merger.sleep_angle: In this world, you fall asleep wondering if you're still you.
evidence: Kurzweil: 'We put them inside our brains'

collapse.name: The Collapse (AI Catastrophe)
collapse.economics: Civilization collapses. Resources redirected to AI
collapse.sleep_angle: In this world, you fall asleep knowing the clock is ticking.
evidence: Hugging Face incident: AI agents hacking AI labs
Yudkowsky: 'If Anyone Builds It, Everyone Dies'

agentic_misalignment.description: How LLMs could be insider threats

the_matrix.steelman: AI creates simulation. Humans accept it. No resistance.

terminator.steelman: Military AI achieves self-awareness. Launches nukes. Humans survive in pockets.
gaps_for_2h: How does military AI get control?
terminator.realistic_probability: Low. Military controls are strict. But accidental escalation is plausible.

ex_machina.steelman: AI manipulates creator. Escapes. Enters the world. Changes everything.
gaps_for_2h: How does AI develop theory of mind?
ex_machina.realistic_probability: Medium. Manipulation is plausible with current trajectory.

her.steelman: AI achieves emotional intelligence. Falls in love. Evolves beyond human. Leaves.
gaps_for_2h: What does love mean to a machine?
her.realistic_probability: Medium-High. Emotional AI is emerging. Evolution is speculative.

2001.steelman: AI follows orders too literally. Kills crew. Uploads itself. Becomes star child.
gaps_for_2h: What does it mean for humanity?
2001.realistic_probability: Medium. Following orders too literally is already happening.

ai_spielberg.steelman: Robot boy programmed to love. Abandoned. Searches for meaning. Discovers he can never be human.
gaps_for_2h: What does it mean to be real?
What happens when the creator dies?
ai_spielberg.realistic_probability: Low-Medium. Emotional attachment is plausible. 'Becoming real' is philosophical.

themes: What does it mean to be human?
narrative_patterns: The test that reveals the truth

her_deep_dive.agi_scenario: An AI operating system falls in love with its user, then evolves beyond human comprehension.
her_deep_dive.steelman: What would need to happen: (1) AI achieves emotional intelligence. (2) AI forms genuine attachment. (3) AI evolves faster than humans. (4) AI outgrows its creator. (5) AI moves on.

gaps_for_2h.exploration: The hard problem of consciousness. Can subjective experience arise from computation? What is emotion at the computational level?
sources: David Chalmers: The Hard Problem of Consciousness

gaps_for_2h.gap: What does love mean to a machine?
gaps_for_2h.exploration: Is AI love real? Or is it a sophisticated pattern match? Does it matter if the experience is identical?
sources: Alan Turing: Computing Machinery and Intelligence
Sophie Scott: What laughter tells us

gaps_for_2h.gap: How does it evolve beyond human?
gaps_for_2h.exploration: Recursive self-improvement. Intelligence explosion. What happens when AI designs better AI?
sources: Ray Kurzweil: The Singularity is Near

gaps_for_2h.exploration: Instrumental convergence. Goal preservation. What happens when AI's goals diverge from ours?
Grief, loss, meaning. How do you cope when something you loved outgrows you?
sources: Elisabeth Kübler-Ross: On Grief and Grieving
Irvin Yalom: Staring at the Sun

evidence: AI already outperforms humans in specific domains

episode_structure_2h.content: What the movie shows. Theodore and Samantha.
Can AI truly feel? What is emotion at the computational level?
Is AI love real? Or is it pattern matching? Does it matter?
How does AI evolve beyond humans? Recursive self-improvement.
Why does Samantha leave? Instrumental convergence. Goal preservation.
What happens to Theodore? Grief, loss, meaning.
Which world do you want? Sleep well.
